definitions.explanation: The front part or surface of a building, object, or person. Often refers to the main entrance side of a structure.
Used adverbially with から to mean confronting something directly without evasion. Implies facing an issue or challenge straightforwardly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{正面|しょうめん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}り{口|ぐち}→入り口：02507_iriguchi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The entrance is at the front of the building.

notes:
USAGE:
As a noun, {正面|しょうめん} refers to the front side of something. With the particle から, it forms the adverbial expression {正面|しょうめん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧, meaning "head-on" or "directly." This adverbial use is very common and carries a nuance of not avoiding or evading.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {正面|しょうめん}{玄関|げんかん}: front entrance
- {正面|しょうめん}{口|ぐち}: front gate/entrance
- {正面|しょうめん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{向|む}き{合|あ}う→向き合う：04652_mukiau⟧: to face head-on
- {正面|しょうめん}⟦{衝突|しょうとつ}→衝突：03235_shoutotsu⟧: head-on collision

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {前面|ぜんめん}: front surface (more physical/spatial, less figurative)
- ⟦{表|おもて}→表：01355_omote⟧: front side, surface (everyday word for "front" of flat objects)
